_panel_era_start_note: The date the adversarial plan panel (FEAT-45) became available in THIS project. INV-32 does not grade a plan signed before it, because a plan signed before the panel existed cannot carry a record of one. null means this project has no pre-panel era, so every approved plan is graded — the right value for a project onboarded after FEAT-45. check-state.sh is copied into every onboarded project, so this MUST be per-project: a hardcoded date would export one repository's history as another's gate (BUG-1071 panel finding F2).
_handoff_done_when_baseline_note: This is the FROZEN list of handoff notes that existed at THIS FEATURE'S BASE COMMIT, `git merge-base main HEAD` = b7956fc4, enumerated from `git ls-tree -r --name-only b7956fc4 -- .harness/harness/features` filtered to files matching notes/handoff-*.md that do not carry a "## Done when" line at that commit. INV-17 does not demand the fifth section for a path in this list, and demands it for every note that is not. The list is finite and MUST NEVER GROW: a note edited after the contract landed is refused at write until it complies, and a note written DURING this feature's own build is a new note that complies (D-08) rather than a baseline entry. It is per-project because check-state.sh is copied into every onboarded project, so a hardcoded list would export this repository's history as another's gate. An empty list is the right value for a project onboarded after this feature.
_test_matrix_note: change_type -> required test kinds. A FLOOR, not a ceiling: qa may add kinds it infers from the diff, never drop below. Predicate names in `when` are FIXED DATA so the gate is auditable; qa evaluates them against the diff. This matrix is PER-PROJECT (DEC-187): every kind it names must exist in test_kinds and be active or excluded, and any change_type differing from the template needs a _matrix_provenance entry with a signed decision. DEC-35's 'fixed data' is the predicate names, not the table.
_matrix_provenance_note: Every change_type whose always/when differs from the template. The baseline is the template as it stood at DEC-187; a later template change does not retroactively make an entry wrong.
_test_kinds_note: EVERY cmd ships as null. dev-ops replaces it with a command it has RUN and seen pass, or leaves it null and REPLACES the placeholder _reason with the real one. NEVER write a plausible-looking command you have not executed: `node --test src/` reports `tests 1 / fail 1` for a module-load error, which reads exactly like a failing suite (DEC-98). A null cmd is BLOCKED in the qa gate, never a skip. The ONLY soft skip is status: excluded with a signed decision id — a human's recorded call, never inferred at gate time (DEC-187). An invented cmd turns a hard gate into a silent no-op, which is worse than either. DELETE the _reason on any kind whose cmd you fill — leaving 'unset, detection has not run' beside a verified command is a lie about the project's own config. `exclude` keeps worktree and vendor dirs out of diff scans — measured 3x test-file inflation in kaya-ai without it. A FOURTH status, `locally_run` (issue #1187), names a kind that is registered and has a real, working `cmd` — unlike `unresolved` — but can structurally never run in CI: it needs a real host and live credentials `tests.yml` does not carry (no `secrets.*`, DEC-201). It is neither a CI-runnable `active` kind nor a dead `excluded` one; suite_layout.py refuses every `probe-*` script left under bin/, while each host-only probe is registered under tests/manual/ in exactly one `locally_run` kind's `detect`, so the check stays discoverable rather than remembered. `runner_note` replaces `excluded_because`/`_reason` to say what host and credentials the cmd needs and where its run record lives.

functional.excluded_because: this repository ships no service API, and run-unit-tests.sh splits its suite by the tests/unit and tests/integration directories. There is no third bucket; pointing functional at either would double-count files the other kind already runs.

omp_session_accessor.runner_note: requires the omp binary on PATH and live anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 credentials (issue #1187); tests.yml carries no secrets.*, so this can never run in CI. Run on a credentialled host before a ship decision that touches inflight_registry.py's session-file resolution, and record the result under the feature's notes/ directory.

handoff_comprehension.runner_note: requires the omp binary on PATH and live model credentials; this can never run in CI. Run on a credentialled host before a ship decision that changes the handoff contract, and record the result under the feature's notes/ directory.

component._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet

ui._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet. If the project has no browser-driver, leave null: qa records `ui: skipped (no browser target)` and does NOT fail.

typecheck._reason: unset — dev-ops has not run detection yet. Not in the matrix; available for qa to add.

_commit_attribution_note: Recovery derives what landed from `git log` rather than trusting a state file, and review scope depends on telling human edits from agent commits (SPEC 15.3).
_dirty_tree_note: A dirty tree halts a team with BLOCKED. Without this whitelist the harness's own run artifacts would deadlock the next run.

budgets._max_total_runs_rationale: INFORMATIONAL, NOT A GATE (issue #79). Cycles count REWORK only (DEC-157), so a first-pass run adds nothing and NOTHING bounded or even counted total runs — FEAT-03 ran 19 times against a 6-cycle count and tripped nothing. Cost was the other long-feature signal and DEC-178 deleted it, so this is the only one left. Set to 20 from measured data: across nine features the range is 1-19 runs (median 14), so this is a tripwire for the runaway, NOT a critique of normal work — a long feature is fine if each run is efficient, resolves issues and advances the SCs. Crossing it emits a NOTE naming those three questions; it never stops a branch. NOTE THE KNOWN UNDER-COUNT: a main-session-direct segment is not a run and never appears in runs:, which on FEAT-07 hid eight of ten tasks, so the count is a FLOOR.
budgets._max_total_cycles_rationale: REWORK loops only (DEC-157): a cycle is a FAIL routed back, an unmet-SC re-dispatch, or a lead-reported send-back — never a first-pass run, which the PLAN's task list already bounds. Ten consecutive rework loops on one feature is the runaway this kills. Per-feature raises are user decisions recorded in feature.json.
budgets._orchestrator_context_warn_tokens_ration: INFORMATIONAL, NOT A GATE. This is a CONTEXT TOKEN COUNT, not money — DEC-178 removed cost tracking entirely and this does not reintroduce it. 200000 is the figure DEC-148's deleted watchdog used, kept rather than re-guessed. Crossing it advises and never refuses. Measured distribution behind it (per the plan's own measurement, not re-derived here): 28 of 76 orchestrator transcripts peaked above it, 10 above twice it, the largest at 750837, corrected method, measured 2026-08-20 within the 30-day retention window.

board._note: The harness's own project board (FEAT-18). THE SIX STATION NAMES ARE FIXED AND MAY NOT BE RENAMED, REORDERED OR EXTENDED (FEAT-41 T-01): stations is an ordered list of exactly backlog, plan, ready, building, review, done, and factory_config.MANDATED_STATIONS is the mandate it is checked against, so this declaration is a checksum rather than a source of names. The board's column names are DERIVED from these six by factory_config.station_column(), the one place in the tree a capitalised station name is produced, so no capital is stored here. Extra columns you add to the board yourself are untouched by the harness. Nothing pins a project_id, field_id or option id — everything resolves BY NAME at runtime so a wrong value fails loudly, because branch-create-gate.sh pinned exactly those and a wrong pinned id did nothing at all, silently. An absent or incomplete board declaration is a loud error naming the offending key; only an explicitly null board means this project has no board. PLACEMENT IS TEMPORARY: #206 moves github, test_matrix and test_kinds to the product, since harness.json holds runtime metadata.
